name: esposter
description: A nice and casual place for posting random things.
author: Jimmy Chen

scripts.bench: vitest bench --run --project scripts && pnpm -r --if-present run bench
scripts.lint: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --disable-nested-config && virrun -- eslint . && virrun -- pnpm -r --parallel run lint
scripts.lint:fix: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --fix --disable-nested-config && virrun -- eslint --fix . && virrun -- pnpm -r --parallel run lint:fix
scripts.lint:fix:packages: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --fix --disable-nested-config packages && virrun -- pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --parallel run lint:fix
scripts.lint:packages: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --disable-nested-config packages && virrun -- pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --parallel run lint
scripts.release: pnpm format:check && pnpm build:packages && pnpm lint:packages && pnpm typecheck:packages && pnpm test:packages && lerna publish --yes
scripts.typecheck: virrun -- tsc && virrun -- pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck

scriptsComments.build: One dependency closure rather than a hand-ordered chain: `--filter "@esposter/web..."` runs `build` for the app and everything it imports, topologically, so nothing here has to know which libraries exist or in what order they go. `build:packages` is a different set: the libraries on their own, which is what CI caches and hands to the checks, with no app in it because nothing imports an app's `dist`. @TODO: restore `pnpm build:docs` to the chain when a bridge build grows the AST navigation API. TypeDoc exits 6 against the `typescript-native-bridge` alias, and `build` is what deploy runs, so the deploy would fail on documentation alone. `build:docs` stays as the probe. See the `build-docs` job in .github/workflows/CI.yaml.
